technical.summary: TRV shows strong bullish structure with price above all key MAs and positive MACD crossovers, but overbought RSI levels and weak ADX trend strength create pullback risk; moderate entry quality suitable for scaled positions with tight stops.

fundamental.summary: TRV shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 18 days present elevated risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed retail sentiment (bearish 42%, bullish 21%) with neutral fear/greed (47) provides no clear directional bias; insufficient data for conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (214.4) indicates extreme market stress, NFP event imminent, and earnings binary in 18 days create compounded downside risk for financials.
